title.narrative: THIS IS AN ADDITIONAL ALLOCATION TO SUPPORT HUMANITARIAN NEEDS AS A RESULT OF THE OCTOBER 2023 ESCALATIONS.

description.narrative: The oPt Humanitarian Fund (HF) plays an important role in supporting the humanitarian response in the oPt. It is designed to allocate funds quickly for unexpected emergencies or unforeseen events, in addition to delivering strategic responses which have been included in the Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) but remain unfunded. In light of the progressive reduction in the level of funding for the HRP the Humanitarian Fund has become even more vital as a tool to meet urgent needs. Ireland has provided support to the HF in 2009 and, in each year over the period 2012-2022, to help meet increased humanitarian needs, particularly in the aftermath of the conflicts in Gaza in May 2021. Ireland has disbursed €300,000 to date in 2023 and this disbursement of €3 million will bring total funding to €3,300,000 in 2023.
